-3x^3 - 5x^2 + 20x - 16 - (-3x^3 - 12x^2) = -5x^2 + 20x - 16.

0 - 16 - (-4x - 16) = 0.

So the quotient q(x) is -3x^2 - 5x - 4, and the remainder r(x) is 0.
